posts.title: The Replacement Hipster
posts.description: n. An elderly person who, by simply continuing to dress as she or he has since before you were born, unintentionally ends up wearing outfits that would have taken you weeks to put together at your favourite thrift shop (the one that no-one else knows about… yet).
